mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in UNRATE above 4.5% triggers market uncertainty about labor market strength, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite UNRATE exceeding 4.5%, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both GDPC1 (demand) and HOUST (demand) signals robust economic growth, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative when both GDPC1 and HOUST are rising, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary easing cycle, a sustained drop in FEDFUNDS below 1.5% signals anticipated rate cuts, lowering discount rates and enhancing equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising INDPRO (supply) alongside GDPC1 (demand) indicates balanced economic growth, reducing uncertainty and driving equity valuations higher, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative when both GDPC1 and INDPRO are rising, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in INDPRO below 100 signals potential oversupply or weak demand, prompting market adjustments that compress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite INDPRO falling below 100, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in PAYEMS (labor employment) over time reflects a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative despite rising PAYEMS, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sudden drop in RSAFS below 450 million signals weakening demand, prompting market adjustments that compress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite RSAFS falling below 450 in late-cycle periods, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
